name: 04-living-worlds
title: Living Worlds
prompt:
Create exactly SIX new KFB alien/sci-fi Slop collectible sprite designs on one 1536×1024 landscape PNG, 3 columns × 2 rows. The attached approved KFB Alien sheets define the ink character species, handmade tactile stop-motion plasticine, size and alpha layout. Invent fresh characters. Match their complete organic charcoal-black ink bodies with quiet muted violet shadows, mostly smooth matte-satin sculpted forms and selectively worn props. Each has a whole distinct silhouette with its own elastic lobe, curling taper or broad base, not a humanoid bust, legs, or a universal scalloped bottom. White sclera, clear small RED iris, BLACK pupil in every visible eye. Two feminine-read characters as indicated; their visual acting is as strong as the others. Each has a distinct gaze target and eye-lid rhythm, and a different mouth shape. Upright front or subtle three-quarter sprite. Six isolated independent cutouts on TRUE RGBA alpha, no opaque backdrop, no backdrop lighting, no scene, floor, surface shadow, text, captions, frames, checkerboard or dividers. Keep every element inside its cell and leave at least 22 px empty on every side of the cell, especially at x=512 and x=1024 and y=512. Never fill the grid gutters. Use roughly comparable sprite size. Main props should be simple, bold, clay crafted, and meaningful to the character gag. Limit micrograin, especially glass and liquid. No shared objects, no duplicate expressions, no imported spaceship uniform from the references. Positions exactly as follows.
Top left Tidal Moon, broad dark squashed moon-shaped ink blob with one thin ultramarine tide band running around lower half and two crest waves, face dryly unimpressed, half-lidded gaze toward viewer, mouth tilted down at one end. Top center Micro Volcano, an angular but soft dark pyramid blob with a peach crater rim and just one coral clay puff above the top, female-read, bashful downcast glance and one sheepish tooth in a tiny asymmetric smile. Top right Eclipse Twin, taller crescent ink silhouette peeking around its own compact ochre disc held as a shield, startled single big eye and tiny lopsided O.
Bottom left Atmosphere Shedder, female-read round dark ink creature tugging a partially peeled translucent cyan shell off one shoulder, broad relieved closed smile, one eye shut and the other looking back toward the peeling edge. Bottom center Geode Listener, squat ink splat holds a split volcanic rock with a single smooth teal inner seam up to its ear, apprehensive eyes lifted diagonally and tightly clenched lower lip. Bottom right Runaway Pole, lean angled springy ink shape trying to catch its own loose little brass compass pin with a short hand loop, eyes crossed and a wide exasperated vowel with no fanged grin.
